notes.title: To the Stars Patch 1.2.53
notes.notes:
We’ve made a couple of changes and improvements based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:

🛠️Bug Fix: Resolved a rare issue where quitting and returning to a constellation would result in no regions being unlocked.
 
✨New Setting: Added a "Nova Defense" option, which simulates always having the Nova Defense item. This prevents passer-by ships from exploding due to planetary shockwaves, while only ships on burning paths to or from explosions will be affected.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073490/To_the_Stars/

notes.title: To the Stars Patch 1.2.52
notes.notes:
The stars are aligning with some updates! We’ve made exciting changes and improvements based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:

[h3]✨ General Changes:[/h3][list]
[*] Balancing adjustments across factions, items, levels, abilities, and shop for smoother gameplay.
[*] Increased difficulty in later constellations for those craving a challenge 🌠.
[*] Win streaks now replenish a lost life—because champions deserve a second chance!
[*] Added Brazilian Portuguese localisation.
[*] Surrender button now available to make tough calls in battle.
[*] New lives UI to track your remaining chances in the heat of battle.
[*] Feel the intensity with visual shakes when planets switch sides 🪐.
[*] Return to menu button added in the defeat popup for a smoother reset.
[*] Enhanced visuals for ability icons and monuments for a better experience.
[/list][h3] 👾 Bug Fixes:[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed minor rendering issues.
[*] The level duplicate bug has been squashed! 🛠️
[*] Escape key functionality is now fixed—no more surprise popups!
[/list]

🚀Ready to take on the stars again? Make sure to update your game and dive into the new features.  ✨

Get ready to dominate the cosmos – To the Stars is available NOW!

notes.title: To the Stars is Launching August 13!
notes.notes:
🌟 Brace yourselves, space adventurers! 🌟 [b]To the Stars[/b], the whimsical tactical planet-hopping roguelike from Stellar Cartography and Blowfish Studios, is launching into orbit on [b]Tuesday, August 13, 2024[/b]! 🚀

Ever wondered what it’s like to rule the universe? Now’s your chance! Conquer alien planets, unlock crazy commanders, and take over the cosmos one constellation at a time. Whether you’re a Fringlot fanatic or a Cryspuritan crusader, there’s a faction for everyone.

Mark your calendars, set your phasers to fun, and get ready to take to the stars! ⭐

If you’re as hyped as we are, please show the game some love by wishlisting it 💖
